result.new_evidence_interpretation: The return circuit lost to both of its controls and to native on the full run. Its worse training CE leaves the cause unresolved. The executed decision witness also missed its prespecified bound. It gives no evidence that relation 28 needs an entangled effect, and no biseparable substitute was constructed. The GHZ example explains why inspecting the learned effect alone cannot settle task utility. I would leave both tests closed. The missing observable I would pursue is whether the ordered subject and object carry joint information that improves a natural relation decision after accounting for their individual native scores.
result.one_hypothesis: At the frozen seed-13 native checkpoint, the sign of a three-state interference term involving the candidate relation, subject and object helps classify directed relations on VALID. Specifically, it improves predictions beyond the term’s magnitude, the two role-specific fidelities, and an equally sized control that assigns orientation by which argument has higher relation fidelity.
result.transfer_and_substance: Use the imaginary part of the third-order Bargmann invariant. It is independent of arbitrary phases assigned to individual token kets, changes sign when two argument slots are exchanged, and can be computed from the existing three-qubit states. The natural question is whether the *direction* of this joint signal helps when the head already knows how strongly each argument matches the relation. A positive paired result would supply evidence about a particular missing interaction in a working NLP decoder. The algebra alone supplies none.
result.theory:
Let P_r be the native relation projector. Let S and O be the equally weighted mean token projectors over the marked subject and object spans. Define c_r = Im Tr(P_r S O) = Tr(P_r [S,O])/(2i). By linearity, this averages the imaginary part of ⟨r|s⟩⟨s|o⟩⟨o|r⟩ over cross-span token pairs. Exchanging the two stored span matrices negates c_r. This is an identity for the readout on fixed states, with no assumption about what re-encoding a swapped sentence would do.

There is an exact ambiguity inside the native model family. Simultaneously conjugate every prepared state by reversing the RZ angles in both preparations. RY and CNOT are real, and the token mapper can implement the reversal by negating the corresponding output rows and biases because tanh is odd. Every native fidelity, attention weight and logit survives, while every c_r changes sign. Thus native training cannot identify an absolute sign convention. A fitted class coefficient absorbs this global ambiguity. The empirical question is whether *variation across examples within one checkpoint* predicts labels. A sharp failure case is a common real representation for all projectors, where every c_r vanishes. Even large nonzero values could have signs perfectly predicted by the simpler role-fidelity ordering. That second case motivates the matched control.

minimal_test.input: Use the frozen seed-13 checkpoint, original valid-token masks, marked argument spans, native logits and labels. Use the first 8,192 TRAIN examples in stored order and all 19,584 VALID examples. Use all 40 classes and the existing Macro evaluator. No TEST access.
minimal_test.intervention: For each candidate r compute a = Tr(P_r S), b = Tr(P_r O), m = |c_r| and d = sign(a−b)m, with sign(0)=0. Fit two additive logit corrections on TRAIN. Both receive a, b and m with separate coefficients per class. The experimental fourth feature is c_r. The control fourth feature is d. The control preserves the interaction magnitude and assigns its sign using a role-aware rule available from native fidelities. Keep the native logit as a fixed offset in both fits.
minimal_test.fixed_selection: Include every selected example irrespective of label, correctness, direction or margin. Intersect spans with the valid-token mask. If either span is empty, set all four corrections’ input features to zero for that example in both arms. Use no new intercept. For each class and feature, divide by its TRAIN root mean square, using divisor one for a zero column. Preserve zero inputs.
minimal_test.budget: One frozen feature extraction and two convex fits of 160 coefficients each. Minimize mean multiclass CE plus 0.001 times the sum of squared coefficients using float64 L-BFGS, up to 300 iterations per fit. Require infinity norm of the objective gradient at most 1e-6. No backbone updates, checkpoint search or hyperparameter selection.
minimal_test.metric: Compute paired VALID mean CE and ordinary VALID Macro for the experimental correction, the matched correction and the unmodified native logits on exactly the same rows.
minimal_test.pass: Require experimental CE at least 0.005 below each comparator and experimental Macro at least 0.003 above each comparator, in absolute units. Both fits must meet the gradient criterion. These are prospective feasibility margins on exposed VALID.
minimal_test.stop: If any inequality fails, stop this mechanism without a full run, subset search, alternate orientation rule or threshold change. If either fit misses numerical convergence, record the experiment as unresolved and stop. A pass qualifies this specific plugin for the authorized independent full-training evaluation.

result.why_distinct: This action leaves native token attention, relation effects and values intact. Its intervention is a single additive decision feature computed jointly from two marked spans. It requires no repeated return circuit, propagation through an entity-scattering operator, biseparable substitution, rank measurement or change to token mass. Both fitted arms observe the interaction magnitude. Their difference tests a concrete choice about the information carried by its sign, and comparison with frozen native checks whether winning that contest improves the actual task.
result.implementation_delta: Add one isolated readout plugin that forms two 8×8 span means per example, contracts them with the 40 existing projectors and emits the two fixed feature tables. Its mechanism checks are direct agreement with an explicit token-pair sum on a small TRAIN batch, sign reversal under stored-slot exchange and invariance of the native logits under simultaneous conjugation. Original model sources stay untouched.
result.claim_ceiling: A pass would establish incremental frozen-head utility at one checkpoint on exposed VALID against the declared direction-aware control. It would leave open whether a richer classical role-interaction model predicts the same signal, whether the gain generalizes, and whether joint training preserves it. The invariant is established mathematics. Process-aware query/key methods and ordered matrix products create substantial prior-method overlap risk, and the formula has a direct classical implementation. The candidate contribution is the native-family ambiguity paired with a successful, independently validated natural-task use of the additional observable. This feasibility study carries no inherited L4 result and leaves L5 NOT_ACCEPTED.
